claim_h1: CLONAL beats SINGLE under SHIFT by >= 2x AND ties/loses to SINGLE under STATIONARY (dynamically-gated conditional benefit)
verdict: CLOSED-NEGATIVE 🔴 — conditional-structure hypothesis FALSIFIED; clonal beats single unconditionally (stationary 95.6% > shift 92.8%), so the dynamical-gated synthesis is rejected.
root_cause: SINGLE policy locks the best variant at t=0; given an N=8 random-init pool in [-1,1] and w_star=-1.5, even the locked best variant is far from optimal, so SINGLE pays large eval loss every epoch — CLONAL's mutate-cull recovers regardless of shift.
anti_tautology_check: Selection uses train_err on rotating x-stream; loss measured on independent eval grid {-2,-1,0,1,2}. Same w_star but different x — could (and did) yield disagreeing rankings; SINGLE's eval loss is NOT defined to equal its train loss.
rng_used: deterministic LCG hash for pool init + clonal mutation only
